6.1 From heuristics to principles从启发式到基本原理

Chapter 5第 5 章 found the sources by maximizing a measure of non-Gaussianity, justified by the central-limit heuristic, and found that kurtosis, the simplest such measure, is fragile. This chapter starts instead from first principles. There are two natural ones. The statistical principle writes down the likelihood of the ICA model and maximizes it; this requires a model for the source densities. The information-theoretic principle asks for outputs that are as independent as possible and measures dependence by mutual information; this requires no model at all. The two lead to the same place: the likelihood equals minus the mutual information of the outputs, minus a term that measures how badly the source model fits, up to a constant. For whitened data, mutual information in turn equals a constant minus the sum of the negentropies of the outputs, which turns the non-Gaussianity heuristic into an exact statement.

Chapter 5第 5 章依据中心极限启发式，通过最大化非高斯性度量来寻找源，并发现最简单的度量峭度很脆弱。本章改从基本原理出发。自然的原理有两个。统计原理写出 ICA 模型的似然并使之最大化，这需要源密度的模型。信息论原理要求输出尽可能独立，并用互信息度量相依性，这完全不需要模型。两条路通向同一个地方：似然在相差一个常数的意义下，等于输出互信息的相反数，再减去一个度量源模型拟合有多差的项。对白化数据，互信息又等于一个常数减去各输出负熵之和，于是非高斯性启发式变成了一个精确的命题。

Along the way we meet the score function, the Infomax principle of Bell & Sejnowski (1995), which turns out to be maximum likelihood in disguise, and a key robustness property: the separating solution solves the likelihood equations for almost any source model, and only its stability depends on the model. The chapter ends with practical approximations of negentropy that keep the robustness kurtosis lacks.

沿途我们会遇到得分函数，遇到 Bell & Sejnowski（1995）的 Infomax 原理（它其实是改头换面的最大似然），以及一个关键的稳健性质：对几乎任何源模型，分离解都满足似然方程，只有它的稳定性依赖于模型。本章最后给出负熵的实用近似，它们具备峭度所缺乏的稳健性。

For a positive density ppp on R\RR that is differentiable, except possibly at isolated points (as the Laplace density at 000), the score function is ψ(u)=−p′(u)/p(u)=−ddulog⁡p(u)\psi(u) = -p'(u)/p(u) = -\frac{d}{du}\log p(u)ψ(u)=−p′(u)/p(u)=−dud​logp(u). The Fisher information of a variable sss with score ψ\psiψ is J=E[ψ(s)2]\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2]J=E[ψ(s)2].

对 R\RR 上处处为正、且除个别孤立点（如拉普拉斯密度的 000 点）外可微的密度 ppp，得分函数定义为 ψ(u)=−p′(u)/p(u)=−ddulog⁡p(u)\psi(u) = -p'(u)/p(u) = -\frac{d}{du}\log p(u)ψ(u)=−p′(u)/p(u)=−dud​logp(u)。记 ψi\psi_iψi​ 为源 sis_isi​ 真实密度的得分函数，φi=−pi′/pi\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_iφi​=−pi′​/pi​ 为模型密度 pip_ipi​ 的得分函数。得分函数为 ψ\psiψ 的变量 sss 的 Fisher 信息为 J=E[ψ(s)2]\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2]J=E[ψ(s)2]。

6.3 Mutual information and the likelihood互信息与似然

Reading the identity. Mutual information uses the outputs’ actual marginal densities. Likelihood inserts the densities we choose. If those choices are wrong, an extra mismatch penalty remains; maximizing one objective need not minimize the other. Keep that distinction in view while following the algebra.

怎样读下面的恒等式。互信息使用输出真实的边缘密度；似然代入的是我们选定的密度。选择错误时，会多出模型失配的惩罚项，因此最大化一个目标未必最小化另一个。跟随代数推导时，请始终保留这个区别。

The information-theoretic route measures the dependence of the outputs by their mutual information, I(y)=∑iH(yi)−H(y)I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)I(y)=∑i​H(yi​)−H(y) (Definition 2.17定义 2.17). It is nonnegative and vanishes exactly when the outputs are independent. Since y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx, the joint entropy satisfies H(y)=H(x)+log⁡∣det⁡W∣H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|H(y)=H(x)+log∣detW∣ (Proposition 2.13命题 2.13), so

信息论的路线用互信息 I(y)=∑iH(yi)−H(y)I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)I(y)=∑i​H(yi​)−H(y) 来度量输出之间的相依性（Definition 2.17定义 2.17）。它非负，且恰在输出独立时为零。由于 y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx，联合熵满足 H(y)=H(x)+log⁡∣det⁡W∣H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|H(y)=H(x)+log∣detW∣（Proposition 2.13命题 2.13），所以

I(y)=∑i=1nH(yi)−H(x)−log⁡∣det⁡W∣.(6.4)I(\by) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} H(y_i) - H(\bx) - \log|\det\bW| .\tag{6.4}I(y)=i=1∑n​H(yi​)−H(x)−log∣detW∣.(6.4)

Only the marginal entropies and log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣ depend on W\bWW; the joint entropy of the data is a constant. Rescaling an output changes H(yi)H(y_i)H(yi​) and log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣ by the same amount, so I(y)I(\by)I(y) is invariant under W↦ΠDW\bW \mapsto \bPi\bD\bWW↦ΠDW, as a measure of independence should be. By Theorem 4.6定理 4.6, if at most one source is Gaussian, the minimizers of I(y)I(\by)I(y) over invertible W\bWW, where I(y)=0I(\by) = 0I(y)=0, are exactly the separating matrices: mutual information is a contrast function in the sense of Comon (1994). The likelihood is tied to it by an exact identity.

只有各边缘熵和 log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣ 依赖于 W\bWW，数据的联合熵是常数。对某个输出做尺度变换，H(yi)H(y_i)H(yi​) 与 log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣ 改变同样的量，所以 I(y)I(\by)I(y) 在 W↦ΠDW\bW \mapsto \bPi\bD\bWW↦ΠDW 下不变，这正是独立性度量应有的性质。由Theorem 4.6定理 4.6，若至多一个源是高斯的，则 I(y)I(\by)I(y) 在可逆矩阵 W\bWW 上的最小点（在那里 I(y)=0I(\by) = 0I(y)=0）恰好是分离矩阵：互信息是 Comon（1994）意义下的对比函数。似然与它之间有一个精确的恒等式。

For every invertible W\bWW such that the entropies and divergences below are finite,

这里第二个期望只涉及 yiy_iyi​，因而是边缘密度之间的散度。

This decomposition (Cardoso, 1997; 1998) explains what maximum likelihood does. If the model densities are correct, both terms vanish at W=A−1\bW = \bA^{-1}W=A−1, which is therefore a global maximum; by Theorem 4.6定理 4.6 every other global maximum is a separating matrix whose outputs again have the model densities. If the model is wrong, the mismatch term is positive even at separation and competes with the mutual information. ML then trades a little dependence for a better marginal fit, and the question becomes whether the trade can move the maximum away from separation (Section 6.6第 6.6 节).

这一分解（Cardoso, 1997; 1998）说明了最大似然在做什么。若模型密度正确，两项都在 W=A−1\bW = \bA^{-1}W=A−1 处为零，因此它是全局最大点；由Theorem 4.6定理 4.6，其他任何全局最大点也都是分离矩阵，且其输出同样具有模型密度。若模型有误，失配项即使在分离点也为正，并与互信息相互竞争。此时最大似然会用一点相依性去换取更好的边缘拟合，问题就变成：这种交换会不会把最大点从分离解处挪走（Section 6.6第 6.6 节）。

6.4 Whitened data: mutual information and negentropy白化数据：互信息与负熵

For whitened data the mutual information takes a transparent form. Recall that the negentropy of a random vector with covariance C\bCC is J(y)=H(yG)−H(y)J(\by) = H(\by_{\mathrm{G}}) - H(\by)J(y)=H(yG​)−H(y), where yG\by_{\mathrm{G}}yG​ is Gaussian with the same covariance; it is nonnegative, vanishes only for Gaussian vectors, and is invariant under invertible linear maps (Definition 2.19定义 2.19). For a scalar with unit variance, H(y)=12log⁡(2πe)−J(y)H(y) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y)H(y)=21​log(2πe)−J(y).

对白化数据，互信息具有一目了然的形式。回忆：协方差为 C\bCC 的随机向量的负熵为 J(y)=H(yG)−H(y)J(\by) = H(\by_{\mathrm{G}}) - H(\by)J(y)=H(yG​)−H(y)，其中 yG\by_{\mathrm{G}}yG​ 是具有相同协方差的高斯向量；它非负，只对高斯向量为零，并且在可逆线性变换下不变（Definition 2.19定义 2.19）。对单位方差的标量，H(y)=12log⁡(2πe)−J(y)H(y) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y)H(y)=21​log(2πe)−J(y)。

Proposition 6.4 (mutual information and negentropy)命题 6.4（互信息与负熵）

Let z\bzz be white and y=Uz\by = \bU\bzy=Uz with U\bUU orthogonal. Then

设 z\bzz 是白的，y=Uz\by = \bU\bzy=Uz，U\bUU 为正交矩阵。则

I(y)=J(z)−∑i=1nJ(yi).(6.6)I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_{i=1}^{n} J(y_i) .\tag{6.6}I(y)=J(z)−i=1∑n​J(yi​).(6.6)

If moreover z=A~s\bz = \tilde\bA\bsz=A~s with independent unit-variance sources, then J(z)=∑iJ(si)J(\bz) = \sum_i J(s_i)J(z)=∑i​J(si​), so ∑iJ(yi)≤∑iJ(si)\sum_i J(y_i) \le \sum_i J(s_i)∑i​J(yi​)≤∑i​J(si​), with equality exactly when the outputs are independent.

若进一步有 z=A~s\bz = \tilde\bA\bsz=A~s，各源独立且方差为一，则 J(z)=∑iJ(si)J(\bz) = \sum_i J(s_i)J(z)=∑i​J(si​)，从而 ∑iJ(yi)≤∑iJ(si)\sum_i J(y_i) \le \sum_i J(s_i)∑i​J(yi​)≤∑i​J(si​)，且等号恰在输出相互独立时成立。

Since ∣det⁡U∣=1|\det\bU| = 1∣detU∣=1, H(y)=H(z)H(\by) = H(\bz)H(y)=H(z). The vector y\byy is again white, so each yiy_iyi​ has unit variance and H(yi)=12log⁡(2πe)−J(yi)H(y_i) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y_i)H(yi​)=21​log(2πe)−J(yi​), while H(z)=n2log⁡(2πe)−J(z)H(\bz) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - J(\bz)H(z)=2n​log(2πe)−J(z). Substituting into I(y)=∑iH(yi)−H(y)I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)I(y)=∑i​H(yi​)−H(y) gives (6.6). By invariance J(z)=J(s)J(\bz) = J(\bs)J(z)=J(s), and J(s)=n2log⁡(2πe)−∑iH(si)=∑iJ(si)J(\bs) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - \sum_i H(s_i) = \sum_i J(s_i)J(s)=2n​log(2πe)−∑i​H(si​)=∑i​J(si​) because the sources are independent with unit variance. The inequality is I(y)≥0I(\by) \ge 0I(y)≥0.

由于 ∣det⁡U∣=1|\det\bU| = 1∣detU∣=1，H(y)=H(z)H(\by) = H(\bz)H(y)=H(z)。y\byy 仍是白的，所以每个 yiy_iyi​ 方差为一，H(yi)=12log⁡(2πe)−J(yi)H(y_i) = \frac12\log(2\pi e) - J(y_i)H(yi​)=21​log(2πe)−J(yi​)；同时 H(z)=n2log⁡(2πe)−J(z)H(\bz) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - J(\bz)H(z)=2n​log(2πe)−J(z)。代入 I(y)=∑iH(yi)−H(y)I(\by) = \sum_i H(y_i) - H(\by)I(y)=∑i​H(yi​)−H(y) 即得 (6.6)。由不变性 J(z)=J(s)J(\bz) = J(\bs)J(z)=J(s)；又因各源独立且方差为一，J(s)=n2log⁡(2πe)−∑iH(si)=∑iJ(si)J(\bs) = \frac n2\log(2\pi e) - \sum_i H(s_i) = \sum_i J(s_i)J(s)=2n​log(2πe)−∑i​H(si​)=∑i​J(si​)。不等式就是 I(y)≥0I(\by) \ge 0I(y)≥0。

Minimizing mutual information over rotations is therefore the same as maximizing the sum of the marginal negentropies. The non-Gaussianity principle of Chapter 5第 5 章 is not a heuristic after all: it is an exact reformulation of independence, with negentropy in the role of kurtosis, and the sources are the rotation that concentrates all the available negentropy ∑iJ(si)\sum_i J(s_i)∑i​J(si​) in the marginals. Without whitening, the same substitution gives the identity I(y)=J(x)−∑iJ(yi)+12log⁡(∏iVar⁡(yi)/det⁡Cy)I(\by) = J(\bx) - \sum_i J(y_i) + \frac12\log\bigl(\prod_i \Var(y_i)/\det\bC_{\by}\bigr)I(y)=J(x)−∑i​J(yi​)+21​log(∏i​Var(yi​)/detCy​) for any invertible W\bWW (Comon, 1994). The last term is nonnegative by Hadamard's inequality and vanishes exactly for uncorrelated outputs, so restricting the search to whitened data and rotations loses nothing.

因此，在旋转上最小化互信息，等价于最大化各边缘负熵之和。Chapter 5第 5 章的非高斯性原理终究不是启发式：它是独立性的精确改写，只是由负熵扮演了峭度的角色；源对应的那个旋转，把全部可用的负熵 ∑iJ(si)\sum_i J(s_i)∑i​J(si​) 都集中到了边缘上。不白化时，同样的代换对任意可逆 W\bWW 给出恒等式 I(y)=J(x)−∑iJ(yi)+12log⁡(∏iVar⁡(yi)/det⁡Cy)I(\by) = J(\bx) - \sum_i J(y_i) + \frac12\log\bigl(\prod_i \Var(y_i)/\det\bC_{\by}\bigr)I(y)=J(x)−∑i​J(yi​)+21​log(∏i​Var(yi​)/detCy​)（Comon, 1994）。由 Hadamard 不等式，最后一项非负，且恰在输出不相关时为零，所以把搜索限制在白化数据与旋转上不会损失什么。

One-unit methods maximize a single negentropy J(w⊤z)J(\bw^\top\bz)J(w⊤z) on the sphere. The entropy power inequality implies that its global maximum is attained at the source with the largest negentropy (Exercise 6.6习题 6.6), the analogue of Proposition 5.1命题 5.1. Negentropy itself, however, requires the density of yyy, which is why Section 6.7第 6.7 节 approximates it.

单单元方法在球面上最大化单个负熵 J(w⊤z)J(\bw^\top\bz)J(w⊤z)。由熵幂不等式，其全局最大值在负熵最大的那个源处取得（Exercise 6.6习题 6.6），这与Proposition 5.1命题 5.1相对应。然而负熵本身需要 yyy 的密度，这正是Section 6.7第 6.7 节要对它做近似的原因。

6.5 Infomax is maximum likelihoodInfomax 即最大似然

Bell & Sejnowski (1995) approached separation from the side of neural networks. A layer of units computes y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx and passes each output through an increasing squashing function gi:R→(0,1)g_i : \R \to (0, 1)gi​:R→(0,1), giving ui=gi(yi)u_i = g_i(y_i)ui​=gi​(yi​). Their Infomax principle maximizes the information that the outputs u\buu carry about the inputs x\bxx; for a deterministic invertible map of continuous variables, however, I(x;u)I(\bx;\bu)I(x;u) is generally infinite and is not a finite optimization objective. With independent additive output noise η\boldsymbol{\eta}η, I(x;u+η)=H(u+η)−H(η)I(\bx;\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta}) = H(\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta})-H(\boldsymbol{\eta})I(x;u+η)=H(u+η)−H(η); in a suitable small-noise limit this motivates maximizing the noiseless output entropy H(u)H(\bu)H(u). The entropy-to-likelihood identity below is exact for the noiseless transform. With the logistic function g(y)=1/(1+e−y)g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})g(y)=1/(1+e−y), the gradient of H(u)H(\bu)H(u) is W−⊤+E[(1−2u)x⊤]\bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\bu)\bx^\top]W−⊤+E[(1−2u)x⊤], and the resulting algorithm separated mixtures of audio signals; it became one of the first widely used ICA methods.

Bell & Sejnowski（1995）从神经网络的角度研究分离问题。一层神经元计算 y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx，再把每个输出送入一个递增的压缩函数 gi:R→(0,1)g_i : \R \to (0, 1)gi​:R→(0,1)，得到 ui=gi(yi)u_i = g_i(y_i)ui​=gi​(yi​)。他们的 Infomax 原理最大化输出 u\buu 所携带的关于输入 x\bxx 的信息；但对于连续变量的确定性可逆映射，I(x;u)I(\bx;\bu)I(x;u) 通常为无穷大，不能直接作为有限的优化目标。加入独立的输出噪声 η\boldsymbol{\eta}η 后，I(x;u+η)=H(u+η)−H(η)I(\bx;\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta}) = H(\bu+\boldsymbol{\eta})-H(\boldsymbol{\eta})I(x;u+η)=H(u+η)−H(η)；在适当的小噪声极限下，这为最大化无噪声输出熵 H(u)H(\bu)H(u) 提供了动机。下面的输出熵与似然恒等式对无噪声变换精确成立。取 logistic 函数 g(y)=1/(1+e−y)g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})g(y)=1/(1+e−y) 时，H(u)H(\bu)H(u) 的梯度为 W−⊤+E[(1−2u)x⊤]\bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\bu)\bx^\top]W−⊤+E[(1−2u)x⊤]；由此得到的算法成功分离了音频信号的混合，成为最早被广泛使用的 ICA 方法之一。

Proposition 6.5 (Infomax and maximum likelihood)命题 6.5（Infomax 与最大似然）

Let each gig_igi​ be differentiable and increasing with gi′=pig_i' = p_igi′​=pi​, that is, gig_igi​ is the distribution function of the model density pip_ipi​. Then for every invertible W\bWW,

设每个 gig_igi​ 可微且递增，并满足 gi′=pig_i' = p_igi′​=pi​，即 gig_igi​ 是模型密度 pip_ipi​ 的分布函数。则对任意可逆矩阵 W\bWW，

H(u)=H(x)+L(W)=−D(py ∥ ∏ipi)≤0.(6.7)H(\bu) = H(\bx) + \mathcal{L}(\bW) = -D\Bigl(p_{\by} \,\Big\|\, \prod_i p_i\Bigr) \le 0 .\tag{6.7}H(u)=H(x)+L(W)=−D(py​​i∏​pi​)≤0.(6.7)

Maximizing the output entropy is therefore maximum likelihood estimation with the model densities gi′g_i'gi′​. The bound 000 is attained exactly when the outputs are independent with densities pip_ipi​, that is, when u\buu is uniform on the unit cube.

因此，最大化输出熵就是以 gi′g_i'gi′​ 为模型密度的最大似然估计。上界 000 恰在输出相互独立且密度为 pip_ipi​ 时取到，也就是 u\buu 在单位立方体上均匀分布时。

Proof.证明

The map y↦u\by \mapsto \buy↦u is smooth and invertible with Jacobian diag⁡(g1′(y1),…,gn′(yn))\diag(g_1'(y_1), \dots, g_n'(y_n))diag(g1′​(y1​),…,gn′​(yn​)), and under such a map the entropy changes by the expected log-Jacobian: H(u)=H(y)+∑iE[log⁡gi′(yi)]H(\bu) = H(\by) + \sum_i \E[\log g_i'(y_i)]H(u)=H(y)+∑i​E[loggi′​(yi​)]. With H(y)=H(x)+log⁡∣det⁡W∣H(\by) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW|H(y)=H(x)+log∣detW∣ and gi′=pig_i' = p_igi′​=pi​ this is H(x)+L(W)H(\bx) + \mathcal{L}(\bW)H(x)+L(W), and Proposition 6.2命题 6.2 gives the divergence form. The equivalence was pointed out by Cardoso (1997) and by Pearlmutter & Parra (1997). For the logistic ggg, the model density g′=g(1−g)g' = g(1 - g)g′=g(1−g) is the logistic density of Table 6.1表 6.1, with score φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh⁡(y/2)\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh(y/2); since −φ(yi)=1−2ui-\varphi(y_i) = 1 - 2u_i−φ(yi​)=1−2ui​, the Bell–Sejnowski gradient is exactly the likelihood gradient (6.3). The logistic density has kurtosis 1.21.21.2, a super-Gaussian model. This explains why Infomax works well for speech and many natural signals, which are super-Gaussian, and why it needs a modification for sub-Gaussian sources (Section 6.6第 6.6 节). Chapter 7第 7 章 develops the natural-gradient form of the algorithm (Algorithm 7.4算法 7.4).

这一等价关系由 Cardoso（1997）以及 Pearlmutter & Parra（1997）指出。对 logistic 函数 ggg，模型密度 g′=g(1−g)g' = g(1 - g)g′=g(1−g) 就是Table 6.1表 6.1中的 logistic 密度，其得分函数为 φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh⁡(y/2)\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh(y/2)；由于 −φ(yi)=1−2ui-\varphi(y_i) = 1 - 2u_i−φ(yi​)=1−2ui​，Bell–Sejnowski 梯度恰好就是似然梯度 (6.3)。logistic 密度的峭度为 1.21.21.2，是一个超高斯模型。这解释了为什么 Infomax 对语音和许多自然信号（它们是超高斯的）效果很好，而对亚高斯源则需要修改（Section 6.6第 6.6 节）。Chapter 7第 7 章给出该算法的自然梯度形式（Algorithm 7.4算法 7.4）。

6.6 When the source model is wrong源模型设错时

In practice the source densities are unknown, and maximum likelihood is run with a fixed model such as the logistic density. This is less dangerous than it sounds, because of a simple property of the estimating equations.

实践中源密度是未知的，最大似然只能用一个固定的模型（例如 logistic 密度）来运行。这并不像听起来那么危险，原因在于估计方程的一个简单性质。

Proposition 6.6 (separation solves the estimating equations)命题 6.6（分离解满足估计方程）

Let the sources be independent with zero mean, let φ1,…,φn\varphi_1, \dots, \varphi_nφ1​,…,φn​ be arbitrary model scores, and suppose that for each iii the scale equation

E[φi(disi) disi]=1(6.8)\E\bigl[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)\, d_i s_i\bigr] = 1\tag{6.8}E[φi​(di​si​)di​si​]=1(6.8)

has a solution di≠0d_i \neq 0di​=0. Then W=DA−1\bW = \bD\bA^{-1}W=DA−1 with D=diag⁡(d1,…,dn)\bD = \diag(d_1, \dots, d_n)D=diag(d1​,…,dn​) satisfies the estimating equations E[φi(yi) yj]=δij\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\, y_j] = \delta_{ij}E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=δij​, so it is a stationary point of L\mathcal{L}L. The same holds for every ordering of the sources, with each model paired with the source it extracts.

有解 di≠0d_i \neq 0di​=0。则 W=DA−1\bW = \bD\bA^{-1}W=DA−1（D=diag⁡(d1,…,dn)\bD = \diag(d_1, \dots, d_n)D=diag(d1​,…,dn​)）满足估计方程 E[φi(yi) yj]=δij\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\, y_j] = \delta_{ij}E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=δij​，因而是 L\mathcal{L}L 的驻点。对源的任意排列也是如此，只需把每个模型与它所提取的源配对。

Proof.证明

Here yi=disiy_i = d_i s_iyi​=di​si​. For i≠ji \neq ji=j, independence and E[sj]=0\E[s_j] = 0E[sj​]=0 give E[φi(disi) djsj]=E[φi(disi)] djE[sj]=0\E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)\, d_j s_j] = \E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)]\, d_j \E[s_j] = 0E[φi​(di​si​)dj​sj​]=E[φi​(di​si​)]dj​E[sj​]=0. 此时 yi=disiy_i = d_i s_iyi​=di​si​。对 i≠ji \neq ji=j，由独立性与 E[sj]=0\E[s_j] = 0E[sj​]=0 得 E[φi(disi) djsj]=E[φi(disi)] djE[sj]=0\E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)\, d_j s_j] = \E[\varphi_i(d_i s_i)]\, d_j \E[s_j] = 0E[φi​(di​si​)dj​sj​]=E[φi​(di​si​)]dj​E[sj​]=0。对 i=ji = ji=j，方程就是尺度方程。

So separation is a stationary point of the likelihood whatever the model, as long as the scale equations can be solved; for a nondegenerate source with finite first absolute moment when φ=tanh⁡\varphi = \tanhφ=tanh, or finite nonzero fourth moment when φ(u)=u3\varphi(u) = u^3φ(u)=u3, they can be solved, because E[φ(ds) ds]\E[\varphi(ds)\,ds]E[φ(ds)ds] grows continuously from 000 to ∞\infty∞ as ddd increases. This is the basis of quasi-maximum likelihood (Pham & Garat, 1997): a crude source model can yield a locally consistent estimator when the separating root is isolated and stable, the sample criterion converges appropriately, and the algorithm selects that root (see below), and a better model improves its accuracy (Chapter 10第 10 章). What the model does decide is whether this stationary point is a maximum of L\mathcal{L}L, and hence a stable point of gradient ascent. Theorem 7.2定理 7.2 gives the conditions. Apart from a condition on single sources, 1+E[φi′(yi) yi2]>01 + \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)\,y_i^2] > 01+E[φi′​(yi​)yi2​]>0, which holds for every model used below, they concern pairs of sources: with γi=E[φi′(yi)] E[yi2]\gamma_i = \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)]\,\E[y_i^2]γi​=E[φi′​(yi​)]E[yi2​] evaluated at the separating point, the pair (i,j)(i, j)(i,j) is stable when γi>0\gamma_i > 0γi​>0, γj>0\gamma_j > 0γj​>0 and γiγj>1\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1γi​γj​>1. Three facts make this concrete.

所以，只要尺度方程有解，无论模型如何，分离解都是似然的驻点；对非退化源，若 φ=tanh⁡\varphi = \tanhφ=tanh 且一阶绝对矩有限，或 φ(u)=u3\varphi(u) = u^3φ(u)=u3 且四阶矩有限且非零，尺度方程有解，因为随着 ddd 增大，E[φ(ds) ds]\E[\varphi(ds)\,ds]E[φ(ds)ds] 从 000 连续增长到 ∞\infty∞。这是拟最大似然的基础（Pham & Garat, 1997）：若分离根孤立且稳定、样本准则适当收敛，并且算法选中了这个根（见下文），粗糙的源模型也可以给出局部相合估计，更好的模型则提高其精度（Chapter 10第 10 章）。模型真正决定的，是这个驻点是否为 L\mathcal{L}L 的极大点，从而是否为梯度上升的稳定点。Theorem 7.2定理 7.2给出了相应条件。除了一个关于单个源的条件 1+E[φi′(yi) yi2]>01 + \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)\,y_i^2] > 01+E[φi′​(yi​)yi2​]>0（下文用到的每个模型都满足它）之外，其余条件都涉及源对：在分离点处计算 γi=E[φi′(yi)] E[yi2]\gamma_i = \E[\varphi_i'(y_i)]\,\E[y_i^2]γi​=E[φi′​(yi​)]E[yi2​]，则当 γi>0\gamma_i > 0γi​>0、γj>0\gamma_j > 0γj​>0 且 γiγj>1\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1γi​γj​>1 时源对 (i,j)(i, j)(i,j) 是稳定的。下面三个事实使之具体化。

  • The true model is stable. With the true score, γi=E[ψi′(si)] σi2=Jiσi2≥1\gamma_i = \E[\psi_i'(s_i)]\,\sigma_i^2 = \mathcal{J}_i\sigma_i^2 \ge 1γi​=E[ψi′​(si​)]σi2​=Ji​σi2​≥1, with equality only for a Gaussian source (Section 6.2第 6.2 节). Every pair is stable as long as at most one source is Gaussian.
  • Gaussian sources sit on the boundary. For a Gaussian source, γi=1\gamma_i = 1γi​=1 for every model, by Stein's identity E[φ(y) y]=σ2E[φ′(y)]\E[\varphi(y)\,y] = \sigma^2\E[\varphi'(y)]E[φ(y)y]=σ2E[φ′(y)] (Exercise 6.3习题 6.3).
  • A wrong model can fail. For φ=tanh⁡\varphi = \tanhφ=tanh, the score of the hyperbolic secant density, γ≈0.76\gamma \approx 0.76γ≈0.76 for a uniform source and γ≈1.41\gamma \approx 1.41γ≈1.41 for a Laplacian one. For φ(u)=u3\varphi(u) = u^3φ(u)=u3, γ=3/(3+κ)\gamma = 3/(3 + \kappa)γ=3/(3+κ) exactly, which is 1.671.671.67 for the uniform and 0.50.50.5 for the Laplace law. So tanh⁡\tanhtanh separates two Laplacian sources (1.412≈2.01.41^2 \approx 2.01.412≈2.0) but not two uniform ones (0.762≈0.580.76^2 \approx 0.580.762≈0.58), and u3u^3u3 does the reverse. For the logistic model of Infomax, φ(u)=tanh⁡(u/2)\varphi(u) = \tanh(u/2)φ(u)=tanh(u/2), the values are 0.850.850.85 and 1.271.271.27, with the same conclusions.
  • 真实模型是稳定的。用真实得分函数时，γi=E[ψi′(si)] σi2=Jiσi2≥1\gamma_i = \E[\psi_i'(s_i)]\,\sigma_i^2 = \mathcal{J}_i\sigma_i^2 \ge 1γi​=E[ψi′​(si​)]σi2​=Ji​σi2​≥1，等号只对高斯源成立（Section 6.2第 6.2 节）。只要至多一个源是高斯的，每一对都是稳定的。

Simulations of the natural-gradient algorithm of Chapter 7第 7 章, started next to the separating point, confirm these predictions for all three models: in the unstable cases the outputs drift away from the sources towards mixtures of the two, and in the stable cases they stay at the scales did_idi​ given by (6.8). A uniform source paired with a Laplacian one is stable under tanh⁡\tanhtanh (0.76×1.41≈1.080.76 \times 1.41 \approx 1.080.76×1.41≈1.08) but not under u3u^3u3 (1.67×0.5≈0.831.67 \times 0.5 \approx 0.831.67×0.5≈0.83), so for a mixture of sub- and super-Gaussian sources no single fixed model of these two types is safe. Algorithms therefore choose the model per output from the data: extended Infomax (Lee, Girolami & Sejnowski, 1999) switches each output between a super-Gaussian and a sub-Gaussian model according to a sign estimated from the current outputs (Section 7.7第 7.7 节). The one-unit contrasts of the next section are squared deviations from the Gaussian value, [EG(y)−EG(ν)]2[\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)]^2[EG(y)−EG(ν)]2, which treat sub- and super-Gaussian departures alike; the conditions under which a source is a local maximum of such a contrast are part of the analysis of FastICA in Chapter 8第 8 章.

从分离点附近出发运行Chapter 7第 7 章的自然梯度算法，模拟结果对这三种模型都证实了上述预言：在不稳定的情形下，输出会离开源，漂向两个源的混合；在稳定的情形下，输出停留在由 (6.8) 给出的尺度 did_idi​ 上。均匀源与拉普拉斯源组成的一对在 tanh⁡\tanhtanh 下稳定（0.76×1.41≈1.080.76 \times 1.41 \approx 1.080.76×1.41≈1.08），在 u3u^3u3 下却不稳定（1.67×0.5≈0.831.67 \times 0.5 \approx 0.831.67×0.5≈0.83）；因此，当亚高斯源与超高斯源混在一起时，这两类固定模型没有一个是保险的。于是算法根据数据为每个输出选择模型：扩展 Infomax（Lee, Girolami & Sejnowski, 1999）根据由当前输出估计出的一个符号，让每个输出在超高斯模型与亚高斯模型之间切换（Section 7.7第 7.7 节）。下一节的单单元对比函数是相对于高斯取值的偏差平方 [EG(y)−EG(ν)]2[\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)]^2[EG(y)−EG(ν)]2，对亚高斯与超高斯的偏离一视同仁；源在什么条件下是这类对比函数的局部极大点，属于Chapter 8第 8 章中对 FastICA 的分析。

6.7 Approximating negentropy负熵的近似

First-pass bridge. Exact entropy needs an entire density; an approximation replaces it with a few measurable averages. This saves estimation effort but discards information. Read the assumptions and the comparison table first; the expansion coefficients and their proofs can wait until a second pass.

第一次阅读的桥接。精确的熵依赖整个密度；近似方法用少数可测的平均值替代它。这减少了估计负担，也丢弃了信息。先看假设与对比表；展开系数及其证明可以留到第二遍。

Negentropy, mutual information and the likelihood all involve densities, which are hard to estimate and awkward to optimize. Practical contrasts replace the negentropy of a standardized output by a function of a few expectations. Throughout this section E[y]=0\E[y] = 0E[y]=0 and E[y2]=1\E[y^2] = 1E[y2]=1, as holds automatically for y=w⊤zy = \bw^\top\bzy=w⊤z with ∥w∥=1\|\bw\| = 1∥w∥=1, and ν∼N(0,1)\nu \sim \Ncal(0, 1)ν∼N(0,1) with density ϕ\phiϕ. For such yyy, negentropy is a divergence from the Gaussian: log⁡ϕ\log\philogϕ is quadratic, so E[log⁡ϕ(y)]=E[log⁡ϕ(ν)]=−H(ν)\E[\log\phi(y)] = \E[\log\phi(\nu)] = -H(\nu)E[logϕ(y)]=E[logϕ(ν)]=−H(ν) and J(y)=H(ν)−H(y)=D(py ∥ ϕ)J(y) = H(\nu) - H(y) = D(p_y \,\|\, \phi)J(y)=H(ν)−H(y)=D(py​∥ϕ).

负熵、互信息与似然都涉及密度，而密度既难以估计，也不便于优化。实用的对比函数用少数几个期望的函数来代替标准化输出的负熵。本节始终假定 E[y]=0\E[y] = 0E[y]=0、E[y2]=1\E[y^2] = 1E[y2]=1（对 ∥w∥=1\|\bw\| = 1∥w∥=1 的 y=w⊤zy = \bw^\top\bzy=w⊤z 这自动成立），并记 ν∼N(0,1)\nu \sim \Ncal(0, 1)ν∼N(0,1)，其密度为 ϕ\phiϕ。对这样的 yyy，负熵就是相对于高斯的散度：log⁡ϕ\log\philogϕ 是二次函数，所以 E[log⁡ϕ(y)]=E[log⁡ϕ(ν)]=−H(ν)\E[\log\phi(y)] = \E[\log\phi(\nu)] = -H(\nu)E[logϕ(y)]=E[logϕ(ν)]=−H(ν)，从而 J(y)=H(ν)−H(y)=D(py ∥ ϕ)J(y) = H(\nu) - H(y) = D(p_y \,\|\, \phi)J(y)=H(ν)−H(y)=D(py​∥ϕ)。

(Exercise 6.5习题 6.5). For symmetric outputs it reduces to kurt⁡(y)2/48\kurt(y)^2/48kurt(y)2/48, so summed over the outputs it is Comon's contrast (5.3) up to the factor 1/481/481/48; combined with Proposition 6.4命题 6.4 this is the sense in which maximizing ∑ikurt⁡(yi)2\sum_i \kurt(y_i)^2∑i​kurt(yi​)2 approximately minimizes mutual information. It also inherits every weakness of kurtosis described in Section 5.6第 5.6 节.

（Exercise 6.5习题 6.5）。对于对称的输出，它化为 kurt⁡(y)2/48\kurt(y)^2/48kurt(y)2/48，所以对各输出求和后，它就是相差因子 1/481/481/48 的 Comon 对比函数 (5.3)；结合Proposition 6.4命题 6.4，这就是“最大化 ∑ikurt⁡(yi)2\sum_i \kurt(y_i)^2∑i​kurt(yi​)2 近似地最小化互信息”的确切含义。它也继承了Section 5.6第 5.6 节所述峭度的全部弱点。

In FastICA the constant plays no role: the one-unit contrast is [EG(w⊤z)−EG(ν)]2[\E G(\bw^\top\bz) - \E G(\nu)]^2[EG(w⊤z)−EG(ν)]2, maximized over the unit sphere (Chapter 8第 8 章). How accurate are these approximations? Table 6.3表 6.3 compares them with the exact negentropy of six unit-variance laws.

在 FastICA 中常数不起作用：单单元对比函数就是在单位球面上最大化 [EG(w⊤z)−EG(ν)]2[\E G(\bw^\top\bz) - \E G(\nu)]^2[EG(w⊤z)−EG(ν)]2（Chapter 8第 8 章）。这些近似有多准？Table 6.3表 6.3把它们与六个单位方差分布的精确负熵作了比较。

None of the approximations is accurate in absolute terms far from the Gaussian, which is not what they were designed for. The cumulant approximation overweights heavy tails (it gives 0.750.750.75 for the t5t_5t5​ law, sixteen times the true value) and returns zero for the zero-kurtosis mixture. The approximations with GGG are of the right size for the three super-Gaussian laws (within about 20%20\%20% with −e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2, within a factor of 1.71.71.7 with log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh), react to the zero-kurtosis mixture, and underestimate strongly sub-Gaussian and skewed laws; an even GGG depends only on the symmetrized density [p(u)+p(−u)]/2[p(u)+p(-u)]/2[p(u)+p(−u)]/2, so it cannot distinguish a density from its reflection or detect a purely antisymmetric perturbation that leaves this symmetrized density unchanged. It can still detect many skewed laws, including the exponential example in the table. Odd functions add information about asymmetry; they are useful rather than mandatory for every skewed source. What matters for ICA, however, is how a contrast varies across the projections of one data set, and there the approximations follow the exact negentropy closely, as Figure 6.1图 6.1 shows.

在远离高斯的地方，这些近似的绝对数值都不准确，这本来也不是它们的设计目标。累积量近似过分看重重尾（对 t5t_5t5​ 分布给出 0.750.750.75，是真值的十六倍），对峭度为零的混合则给出零。基于 GGG 的近似对三个超高斯分布给出了量级正确的值（用 −e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2 时误差约在 20%20\%20% 以内，用 log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh 时在 1.71.71.7 倍以内），能对峭度为零的混合作出反应，但低估了强亚高斯分布与偏斜分布；偶函数 GGG 只依赖于对称化密度 [p(u)+p(−u)]/2[p(u)+p(-u)]/2[p(u)+p(−u)]/2，因此不能区分一个密度与其镜像，也不能发现保持对称化密度不变的纯反对称扰动。但它仍能检测许多偏斜分布，表中的指数分布就是一例。奇函数提供额外的不对称性信息，并非对每个偏斜源都不可缺少。不过，对 ICA 真正重要的是对比函数在同一组数据的不同投影之间如何变化，而在这一点上，这些近似紧紧跟随精确负熵，如Figure 6.1图 6.1所示。

Why these approximations are more robust为什么这些近似更稳健

The advantages over kurtosis come from the slow growth of GGG. First, variance: the sample average E^[G(y)]\hat\E[G(y)]E^[G(y)] has variance Var⁡(G(y))/T\Var(G(y))/TVar(G(y))/T, which is finite as soon as E[G(y)2]<∞\E[G(y)^2] < \inftyE[G(y)2]<∞. Since 0≤log⁡cosh⁡u≤∣u∣0 \le \log\cosh u \le |u|0≤logcoshu≤∣u∣, a finite variance of yyy suffices for G=log⁡cosh⁡G = \log\coshG=logcosh, and −e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2 is bounded, so it needs no moment at all; the sample kurtosis needs m8<∞m_8 < \inftym8​<∞ (Proposition 5.6命题 5.6). Second, influence: one observation x0x_0x0​ moves E^[G(y)]\hat\E[G(y)]E^[G(y)] by roughly G(x0)/TG(x_0)/TG(x0​)/T, which is at most about ∣x0∣/T|x_0|/T∣x0​∣/T for log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh and at most 1/T1/T1/T for −e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2, against x04/Tx_0^4/Tx04​/T for the fourth moment. Third, sensitivity: they respond to departures from Gaussianity that leave the fourth moment unchanged. The following script compares the sample kurtosis with the log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh statistic on Gaussian data and on the zero-kurtosis source.

相对于峭度的优势来自 GGG 的缓慢增长。其一是方差：样本平均 E^[G(y)]\hat\E[G(y)]E^[G(y)] 的方差为 Var⁡(G(y))/T\Var(G(y))/TVar(G(y))/T，只要 E[G(y)2]<∞\E[G(y)^2] < \inftyE[G(y)2]<∞ 就有限。由于 0≤log⁡cosh⁡u≤∣u∣0 \le \log\cosh u \le |u|0≤logcoshu≤∣u∣，对 G=log⁡cosh⁡G = \log\coshG=logcosh 只需 yyy 的方差有限；−e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2 有界，完全不需要矩条件；而样本峭度需要 m8<∞m_8 < \inftym8​<∞（Proposition 5.6命题 5.6）。其二是影响：单个观测 x0x_0x0​ 使 E^[G(y)]\hat\E[G(y)]E^[G(y)] 变化约 G(x0)/TG(x_0)/TG(x0​)/T，对 log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh 至多约为 ∣x0∣/T|x_0|/T∣x0​∣/T，对 −e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2 至多为 1/T1/T1/T，而对四阶矩则是 x04/Tx_0^4/Tx04​/T。其三是敏感性：它们能察觉不改变四阶矩的那些对高斯的偏离。下面的脚本在高斯数据和峭度为零的源上，比较样本峭度与 log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh 统计量。

import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
T, runs = 10000, 300
EG_nu = 0.374567                          # E log cosh(nu), nu ~ N(0, 1)

def logcosh(u):
    return np.abs(u) + np.log1p(np.exp(-2 * np.abs(u))) - np.log(2)

def zero_kurtosis_source(size):
    """Uniform with probability 5/7, Laplacian with probability 2/7."""
    pick = rng.random(size) < 5 / 7
    return np.where(pick, rng.uniform(-np.sqrt(3), np.sqrt(3), size),
                    rng.laplace(0.0, 1 / np.sqrt(2), size))

sources = [("Gaussian", rng.standard_normal),
           ("zero-kurtosis", zero_kurtosis_source)]
for name, draw in sources:
    k, g = [], []
    for _ in range(runs):
        y = draw(T)
        y = (y - y.mean()) / y.std()              # standardize
        k.append(np.mean(y**4) - 3)               # sample kurtosis
        g.append(np.mean(logcosh(y)) - EG_nu)     # E G(y) - E G(nu)
    print(f"{name:14s} kurtosis {np.mean(k):+.3f} +/- {np.std(k):.3f}   "
          f"G-statistic {np.mean(g):+.4f} +/- {np.std(g):.4f}")

Over 300 samples of size T=10000T = 10000T=10000, the sample kurtosis is +0.003±0.049+0.003 \pm 0.049+0.003±0.049 for Gaussian data and +0.017±0.230+0.017 \pm 0.230+0.017±0.230 for the zero-kurtosis source: kurtosis cannot tell them apart, and its spread is almost five times larger for the non-Gaussian law. The log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh statistic EG(y)−EG(ν)\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)EG(y)−EG(ν) is −0.0001±0.0008-0.0001 \pm 0.0008−0.0001±0.0008 for the Gaussian and +0.0087±0.0015+0.0087 \pm 0.0015+0.0087±0.0015 for the zero-kurtosis source, a separation of about six standard deviations. (The logarithm is written in a form that does not overflow for large ∣u∣|u|∣u∣.)

对 300 个样本量为 T=10000T = 10000T=10000 的样本，高斯数据的样本峭度为 +0.003±0.049+0.003 \pm 0.049+0.003±0.049，峭度为零的源为 +0.017±0.230+0.017 \pm 0.230+0.017±0.230：峭度区分不了二者，而且对这个非高斯分布，它的离散程度大了将近五倍。log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh 统计量 EG(y)−EG(ν)\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)EG(y)−EG(ν) 对高斯数据为 −0.0001±0.0008-0.0001 \pm 0.0008−0.0001±0.0008，对峭度为零的源为 +0.0087±0.0015+0.0087 \pm 0.0015+0.0087±0.0015，两者相差约六个标准差。（代码中对数的写法保证 ∣u∣|u|∣u∣ 很大时也不会溢出。）

6.8 A map of contrast functions对比函数一览

Table 6.4表 6.4 collects the contrasts of Part II and the chapters where they are turned into algorithms. They fall into two families: those built on densities (mutual information, likelihood, Infomax, negentropy), which are linked by exact identities, and their moment-based or function-based approximations (kurtosis, cumulants, GGG-functions). Hyvärinen, Karhunen & Oja (2001) give a textbook account of these contrasts and of the algorithms built on them.

Table 6.4表 6.4汇总了第二部分的对比函数，以及把它们变成算法的章节。它们分为两大类：基于密度的（互信息、似然、Infomax、负熵），彼此由精确恒等式联系；以及它们基于矩或基于函数 GGG 的近似（峭度、累积量、GGG 函数）。Hyvärinen, Karhunen & Oja（2001）对这些对比函数以及由此构造的算法有系统的教科书式论述。

6.9 Using likelihood without overinterpreting it如何使用似然而不作过度解读

Keep the statistical model explicit. A likelihood value is meaningful only with its normalized marginal densities, the change-of-variables term, and the data units. Omitting a density normalizer is harmless only when it is independent of every fitted parameter; this matters when fitting scale or shape parameters. Comparing unmixing matrices by ∑iE^log⁡pi(yi)\sum_i\hat\E\log p_i(y_i)∑i​E^logpi​(yi​) alone omits log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣ and rewards spurious scale changes. A singular W\bWW has no square change-of-variables likelihood.

明确统计模型。似然值必须连同归一化的边缘密度、变量变换项和数据单位一起解释。只有归一化常数与所有待拟合参数无关时才能忽略它，拟合尺度或形状参数时尤其需要注意。只用 ∑iE^log⁡pi(yi)\sum_i\hat\E\log p_i(y_i)∑i​E^logpi​(yi​) 比较解混矩阵会漏掉 log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣，从而错误奖励尺度变化。W\bWW 奇异时，方阵变量变换的似然不成立。

Stationarity does not certify independence. Monitor ∥I−E^[φ(y)y⊤]∥F\|\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]\|_F∥I−E^[φ(y)y⊤]∥F​, the objective, convergence across starts and residual dependence on held-out data. A small residual can occur at an unwanted stationary point; low correlation checks only second-order structure. For a fixed standard-Gaussian source model and whitened data, every orthogonal rotation has the same likelihood although most rotations still mix non-Gaussian sources. The identity Proposition 6.2命题 6.2 explains the cancellation between dependence and marginal mismatch.

驻点不证明独立性。同时监测 ∥I−E^[φ(y)y⊤]∥F\|\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]\|_F∥I−E^[φ(y)y⊤]∥F​、目标函数、不同初值的收敛结果以及留出数据上的残余依赖。很小的残差也可能对应不需要的驻点；很小的相关系数只检查二阶结构。若源模型固定为标准高斯分布，数据已白化，则所有正交旋转都有相同的似然，但大多数旋转仍然混合着非高斯源。Proposition 6.2命题 6.2解释了依赖项与边缘失配项如何相互抵消。

Separate fitting from assessment. Estimate the mean, whitening transform, unmixing matrix and density parameters on training observations, then apply the fixed transformations to held-out observations. Higher held-out likelihood supports predictive fit of that model, not the physical meaning of its components. For dependent observations, use time-block or subject-level splits appropriate to the sampling design. An optimized wrong model can still prefer dependent outputs.

区分拟合与评价。用训练观测估计均值、白化变换、解混矩阵和密度参数，再将固定变换用于留出观测。较高的留出似然支持模型的预测拟合，并不证明成分具有物理意义。观测之间有依赖时，应根据抽样设计按时间块或被试划分数据。即使一个错误模型被完全优化，它仍可能偏好有依赖的输出。

Distinguish a local expansion from a density. A truncated Gram–Charlier expression or ϕ(1+ηG~)\phi(1+\eta\tilde G)ϕ(1+ηG~) need not stay nonnegative in the tails. The normalization and moment calculations describe a formal local expansion; they do not make the truncated expression a valid probability density for arbitrary coefficients. Likewise, a slowly growing GGG limits the influence on its sample average at a fixed projection, but empirical centering and covariance whitening can still be strongly affected by outliers.

区分局部展开与概率密度。截断的 Gram–Charlier 表达式或 ϕ(1+ηG~)\phi(1+\eta\tilde G)ϕ(1+ηG~) 在尾部未必非负。归一化与矩的计算描述的是形式局部展开，并不保证任意系数下的截断式都是有效概率密度。同样，增长较慢的 GGG 可以限制固定投影下单点对样本平均的影响，但经验中心化与协方差白化仍可能受到离群值的强烈影响。

A score derivative needs regularity. For Laplace sources ψ(s)=2sign⁡(s)\psi(s)=\sqrt2\sign(s)ψ(s)=2​sign(s) and J=2\mathcal J=2J=2, but the ordinary derivative of ψ\psiψ is zero away from the origin. Inserting that derivative into E[ψ′]=J\E[\psi']=\mathcal JE[ψ′]=J would incorrectly give zero: the jump contributes a boundary term, or a delta mass in the distributional derivative. Use nonsmooth estimating-equation theory or a smooth score approximation; do not implement Laplace FastICA by taking sign and setting its derivative to zero.

得分函数的导数需要正则条件。对拉普拉斯源，ψ(s)=2sign⁡(s)\psi(s)=\sqrt2\sign(s)ψ(s)=2​sign(s)，J=2\mathcal J=2J=2，但 ψ\psiψ 的普通导数在原点以外都为零。直接将该导数代入 E[ψ′]=J\E[\psi']=\mathcal JE[ψ′]=J 会错误地得到零：跳跃带来了边界项，也可用分布导数中的 delta 质量表示。应采用非光滑估计方程理论或光滑得分近似，不能简单用 sign 并把其导数设为零来实现拉普拉斯 FastICA。

Key points

本章要点

  • The change of variables gives the likelihood log⁡L(W)=∑t∑ilog⁡pi(wi⊤x(t))+Tlog⁡∣det⁡W∣\log L(\bW) = \sum_t\sum_i \log p_i(\bw_i^\top\bx(t)) + T\log|\det\bW|logL(W)=∑t​∑i​logpi​(wi⊤​x(t))+Tlog∣detW∣; its stationary points solve the estimating equations E[φi(yi)yj]=δij\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \delta_{ij}E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=δij​, with φi=−pi′/pi\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_iφi​=−pi′​/pi​ the model scores.
  • Exactly, L(W)=−H(x)−I(y)−∑iD(pyi∥pi)\mathcal{L}(\bW) = -H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)L(W)=−H(x)−I(y)−∑i​D(pyi​​∥pi​): maximum likelihood minimizes the dependence of the outputs plus the mismatch of their marginals with the model.
  • For whitened data and rotations, I(y)=J(z)−∑iJ(yi)I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)I(y)=J(z)−∑i​J(yi​): minimizing dependence is maximizing the non-Gaussianity of the outputs.
  • Infomax with squashing functions gig_igi​ is maximum likelihood with model densities gi′g_i'gi′​; the logistic choice is a super-Gaussian model.
  • When the scale equations have solutions and the expectations exist, separation solves the estimating equations after rescaling; only its stability depends on the model, through the conditions γi>0\gamma_i > 0γi​>0 and γiγj>1\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1γi​γj​>1 for every pair. The true score is always stable when at most one source is Gaussian, while a fixed sub- or super-Gaussian model can fail, which is why models are switched per output.
  • Negentropy can be approximated by 112κ32+148κ42\frac1{12}\kappa_3^2 + \frac1{48}\kappa_4^2121​κ32​+481​κ42​, which inherits the weaknesses of kurtosis, or by kG[EG(y)−EG(ν)]2k_G[\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)]^2kG​[EG(y)−EG(ν)]2 with log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh or −e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2, which needs weaker moment conditions and sees beyond the fourth moment; the robustness of the full procedure also depends on centering and whitening.
  • 变量替换给出似然 log⁡L(W)=∑t∑ilog⁡pi(wi⊤x(t))+Tlog⁡∣det⁡W∣\log L(\bW) = \sum_t\sum_i \log p_i(\bw_i^\top\bx(t)) + T\log|\det\bW|logL(W)=∑t​∑i​logpi​(wi⊤​x(t))+Tlog∣detW∣；其驻点满足估计方程 E[φi(yi)yj]=δij\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \delta_{ij}E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=δij​，其中 φi=−pi′/pi\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_iφi​=−pi′​/pi​ 是模型得分函数。
  • 精确地有 L(W)=−H(x)−I(y)−∑iD(pyi∥pi)\mathcal{L}(\bW) = -H(\bx) - I(\by) - \sum_i D(p_{y_i}\|p_i)L(W)=−H(x)−I(y)−∑i​D(pyi​​∥pi​)：最大似然最小化的是输出的相依性加上其边缘分布与模型的失配。
  • 对白化数据与旋转，I(y)=J(z)−∑iJ(yi)I(\by) = J(\bz) - \sum_i J(y_i)I(y)=J(z)−∑i​J(yi​)：最小化相依性就是最大化输出的非高斯性。
  • 以 gig_igi​ 为压缩函数的 Infomax 就是以 gi′g_i'gi′​ 为模型密度的最大似然；logistic 函数对应超高斯模型。
  • 尺度方程有解且有关期望存在时，经过尺度调整后分离解满足估计方程；只有它的稳定性依赖于模型，由条件 γi>0\gamma_i > 0γi​>0 以及对每一对源的 γiγj>1\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1γi​γj​>1 决定。至多一个源是高斯时，真实得分函数总是稳定的；固定的亚高斯或超高斯模型则可能失败，这就是要为每个输出切换模型的原因。
  • 负熵可以用 112κ32+148κ42\frac1{12}\kappa_3^2 + \frac1{48}\kappa_4^2121​κ32​+481​κ42​ 近似，它继承了峭度的弱点；也可以用 kG[EG(y)−EG(ν)]2k_G[\E G(y) - \E G(\nu)]^2kG​[EG(y)−EG(ν)]2（取 log⁡cosh⁡\log\coshlogcosh 或 −e−u2/2-e^{-u^2/2}−e−u2/2）近似，后者只需较弱的矩条件，并能看到四阶矩以外的信息；整个过程的稳健性还取决于中心化与白化。

Before the exercises

开始习题前

  • Keep density normalization and the determinant together.
  • Separate model fit, stationarity and independence in your explanation.
  • Use approximate negentropy only under its stated conditions.
  • 把密度归一化与行列式项一起保留。
  • 解释结果时区分模型拟合、驻点与独立性。
  • 只在所列条件下使用负熵近似。

Start with the score-functions exercise, then the scale-invariance exercise. Leave the Gram–Charlier and entropy-power proofs for your second pass.

先做得分函数习题，再做尺度不变性习题。Gram–Charlier 与熵幂不等式的证明可留到第二遍。

Exercise 6.1习题 6.1 basic基础

(a) Compute the score of the unit-variance Laplace density p(u)=12e−2∣u∣p(u) = \frac{1}{\sqrt2}e^{-\sqrt2|u|}p(u)=2​1​e−2​∣u∣, and verify E[ψ(s)s]=1\E[\psi(s)s] = 1E[ψ(s)s]=1 and J=2\mathcal{J} = 2J=2. (b) Show that the score of the logistic density e−u/(1+e−u)2e^{-u}/(1+e^{-u})^2e−u/(1+e−u)2 is tanh⁡(u/2)\tanh(u/2)tanh(u/2) and that the score of 1/(πcosh⁡u)1/(\pi\cosh u)1/(πcoshu) is tanh⁡u\tanh utanhu.

（a）求单位方差拉普拉斯密度 p(u)=12e−2∣u∣p(u) = \frac{1}{\sqrt2}e^{-\sqrt2|u|}p(u)=2​1​e−2​∣u∣ 的得分函数，并验证 E[ψ(s)s]=1\E[\psi(s)s] = 1E[ψ(s)s]=1 与 J=2\mathcal{J} = 2J=2。（b）证明 logistic 密度 e−u/(1+e−u)2e^{-u}/(1+e^{-u})^2e−u/(1+e−u)2 的得分函数为 tanh⁡(u/2)\tanh(u/2)tanh(u/2)，而 1/(πcosh⁡u)1/(\pi\cosh u)1/(πcoshu) 的得分函数为 tanh⁡u\tanh utanhu。

Show solution查看解答

(a) log⁡p(u)=−12log⁡2−2∣u∣\log p(u) = -\frac12\log 2 - \sqrt2|u|logp(u)=−21​log2−2​∣u∣, so ψ(u)=2 sign⁡(u)\psi(u) = \sqrt2\,\sign(u)ψ(u)=2​sign(u) for u≠0u \neq 0u=0. The mean absolute value of a Laplace variable equals its scale, here 1/21/\sqrt21/2​, so E[ψ(s)s]=2 E∣s∣=1\E[\psi(s)s] = \sqrt2\,\E|s| = 1E[ψ(s)s]=2​E∣s∣=1, and J=E[ψ(s)2]=2\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2] = 2J=E[ψ(s)2]=2, which exceeds the Gaussian value 111. (b) For the logistic density, log⁡p(u)=−u−2log⁡(1+e−u)\log p(u) = -u - 2\log(1 + e^{-u})logp(u)=−u−2log(1+e−u), whose derivative is −1+2e−u/(1+e−u)=−(1−e−u)/(1+e−u)=−tanh⁡(u/2)-1 + 2e^{-u}/(1 + e^{-u}) = -(1 - e^{-u})/(1 + e^{-u}) = -\tanh(u/2)−1+2e−u/(1+e−u)=−(1−e−u)/(1+e−u)=−tanh(u/2); hence ψ(u)=tanh⁡(u/2)\psi(u) = \tanh(u/2)ψ(u)=tanh(u/2). For the hyperbolic secant density, log⁡p(u)=−log⁡π−log⁡cosh⁡u\log p(u) = -\log\pi - \log\cosh ulogp(u)=−logπ−logcoshu, whose derivative is −tanh⁡u-\tanh u−tanhu, so ψ(u)=tanh⁡u\psi(u) = \tanh uψ(u)=tanhu. Both scores saturate, as befits super-Gaussian densities.

（a）log⁡p(u)=−12log⁡2−2∣u∣\log p(u) = -\frac12\log 2 - \sqrt2|u|logp(u)=−21​log2−2​∣u∣，所以 u≠0u \neq 0u=0 时 ψ(u)=2 sign⁡(u)\psi(u) = \sqrt2\,\sign(u)ψ(u)=2​sign(u)。拉普拉斯变量的平均绝对值等于其尺度参数，这里为 1/21/\sqrt21/2​，故 E[ψ(s)s]=2 E∣s∣=1\E[\psi(s)s] = \sqrt2\,\E|s| = 1E[ψ(s)s]=2​E∣s∣=1，且 J=E[ψ(s)2]=2\mathcal{J} = \E[\psi(s)^2] = 2J=E[ψ(s)2]=2，大于高斯分布的取值 111。（b）对 logistic 密度，log⁡p(u)=−u−2log⁡(1+e−u)\log p(u) = -u - 2\log(1 + e^{-u})logp(u)=−u−2log(1+e−u)，其导数为 −1+2e−u/(1+e−u)=−(1−e−u)/(1+e−u)=−tanh⁡(u/2)-1 + 2e^{-u}/(1 + e^{-u}) = -(1 - e^{-u})/(1 + e^{-u}) = -\tanh(u/2)−1+2e−u/(1+e−u)=−(1−e−u)/(1+e−u)=−tanh(u/2)，因此 ψ(u)=tanh⁡(u/2)\psi(u) = \tanh(u/2)ψ(u)=tanh(u/2)。对双曲正割密度，log⁡p(u)=−log⁡π−log⁡cosh⁡u\log p(u) = -\log\pi - \log\cosh ulogp(u)=−logπ−logcoshu，其导数为 −tanh⁡u-\tanh u−tanhu，所以 ψ(u)=tanh⁡u\psi(u) = \tanh uψ(u)=tanhu。两个得分函数都是饱和的，这与超高斯密度相符。

Show that the condition ∂L(DW)/∂di=0\partial\mathcal{L}(\bD\bW)/\partial d_i = 0∂L(DW)/∂di​=0 at D=I\bD = \bID=I is the diagonal estimating equation E[φi(yi)yi]=1\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_i] = 1E[φi​(yi​)yi​]=1.

H(diyi)=H(yi)+log⁡∣di∣H(d_i y_i) = H(y_i) + \log|d_i|H(di​yi​)=H(yi​)+log∣di​∣ and H(Dy)=H(y)+∑ilog⁡∣di∣H(\bD\by) = H(\by) + \sum_i\log|d_i|H(Dy)=H(y)+∑i​log∣di​∣, so the logarithms cancel in I(Dy)=∑iH(diyi)−H(Dy)I(\bD\by) = \sum_i H(d_iy_i) - H(\bD\by)I(Dy)=∑i​H(di​yi​)−H(Dy). On the other hand L(DW)=∑iE[log⁡pi(diyi)]+log⁡∣det⁡W∣+∑ilog⁡∣di∣\mathcal{L}(\bD\bW) = \sum_i \E[\log p_i(d_i y_i)] + \log|\det\bW| + \sum_i \log|d_i|L(DW)=∑i​E[logpi​(di​yi​)]+log∣detW∣+∑i​log∣di​∣, which changes with D\bDD unless the pip_ipi​ have a special form. Its derivative with respect to did_idi​ is −E[φi(diyi) yi]+1/di-\E[\varphi_i(d_iy_i)\,y_i] + 1/d_i−E[φi​(di​yi​)yi​]+1/di​, which at di=1d_i = 1di​=1 vanishes exactly when E[φi(yi)yi]=1\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_i] = 1E[φi​(yi​)yi​]=1. The diagonal estimating equations therefore only fix the scales of the outputs, the one thing that mutual information ignores; the off-diagonal equations carry the information about independence.

H(diyi)=H(yi)+log⁡∣di∣H(d_i y_i) = H(y_i) + \log|d_i|H(di​yi​)=H(yi​)+log∣di​∣，H(Dy)=H(y)+∑ilog⁡∣di∣H(\bD\by) = H(\by) + \sum_i\log|d_i|H(Dy)=H(y)+∑i​log∣di​∣，所以在 I(Dy)=∑iH(diyi)−H(Dy)I(\bD\by) = \sum_i H(d_iy_i) - H(\bD\by)I(Dy)=∑i​H(di​yi​)−H(Dy) 中这些对数项相互抵消。另一方面，L(DW)=∑iE[log⁡pi(diyi)]+log⁡∣det⁡W∣+∑ilog⁡∣di∣\mathcal{L}(\bD\bW) = \sum_i \E[\log p_i(d_i y_i)] + \log|\det\bW| + \sum_i \log|d_i|L(DW)=∑i​E[logpi​(di​yi​)]+log∣detW∣+∑i​log∣di​∣，除非 pip_ipi​ 具有特殊形式，否则它随 D\bDD 变化。它对 did_idi​ 的导数为 −E[φi(diyi) yi]+1/di-\E[\varphi_i(d_iy_i)\,y_i] + 1/d_i−E[φi​(di​yi​)yi​]+1/di​，在 di=1d_i = 1di​=1 处为零当且仅当 E[φi(yi)yi]=1\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_i] = 1E[φi​(yi​)yi​]=1。因此对角估计方程只确定输出的尺度，而这恰恰是互信息所不关心的；关于独立性的信息由非对角方程承载。

Exercise 6.6习题 6.6 advanced硬核

The entropy power inequality states that for independent random variables XXX and YYY with densities, finite variances and finite differential entropies, e2H(X+Y)≥e2H(X)+e2H(Y)e^{2H(X+Y)} \ge e^{2H(X)} + e^{2H(Y)}e2H(X+Y)≥e2H(X)+e2H(Y), with equality only if XXX and YYY are Gaussian (Cover & Thomas, 2006). Let s\bss have independent unit-variance components with densities and finite differential entropies, and let y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s with ∥q∥=1\|\bq\| = 1∥q∥=1. Show that J(y)≤max⁡iJ(si)J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)J(y)≤maxi​J(si​), and that if some source is non-Gaussian, equality holds only for q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​ with J(si)=max⁡jJ(sj)J(s_i) = \max_j J(s_j)J(si​)=maxj​J(sj​).

熵幂不等式断言：对具有密度、有限方差和有限微分熵的独立随机变量 XXX 与 YYY，e2H(X+Y)≥e2H(X)+e2H(Y)e^{2H(X+Y)} \ge e^{2H(X)} + e^{2H(Y)}e2H(X+Y)≥e2H(X)+e2H(Y)，等号仅当 XXX 与 YYY 都是高斯时成立（Cover & Thomas, 2006）。设 s\bss 的各分量独立、方差为一、有密度且微分熵有限，令 y=q⊤sy = \bq^\top\bsy=q⊤s，∥q∥=1\|\bq\| = 1∥q∥=1。证明 J(y)≤max⁡iJ(si)J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)J(y)≤maxi​J(si​)；并证明若有某个源非高斯，则等号仅在 q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​ 且 J(si)=max⁡jJ(sj)J(s_i) = \max_j J(s_j)J(si​)=maxj​J(sj​) 时成立。

By induction the inequality extends to finite sums of independent variables, e2H(∑iXi)≥∑ie2H(Xi)e^{2H(\sum_i X_i)} \ge \sum_i e^{2H(X_i)}e2H(∑i​Xi​)≥∑i​e2H(Xi​), with equality only if all XiX_iXi​ are Gaussian. Apply it to Xi=qisiX_i = q_i s_iXi​=qi​si​ for the indices with qi≠0q_i \neq 0qi​=0. Since H(qisi)=H(si)+log⁡∣qi∣H(q_i s_i) = H(s_i) + \log|q_i|H(qi​si​)=H(si​)+log∣qi​∣, we have e2H(Xi)=qi2e2H(si)e^{2H(X_i)} = q_i^2 e^{2H(s_i)}e2H(Xi​)=qi2​e2H(si​). The sources sis_isi​ and the final projection yyy have unit variance (the scaled summands XiX_iXi​ generally do not), so H(⋅)=h−J(⋅)H(\cdot) = h - J(\cdot)H(⋅)=h−J(⋅) with h=12log⁡(2πe)h = \frac12\log(2\pi e)h=21​log(2πe), and the inequality becomes e−2J(y)≥∑iqi2e−2J(si)e^{-2J(y)} \ge \sum_i q_i^2 e^{-2J(s_i)}e−2J(y)≥∑i​qi2​e−2J(si​). Since the weights qi2q_i^2qi2​ sum to one, the right side is at least e−2max⁡iJ(si)e^{-2\max_i J(s_i)}e−2maxi​J(si​), hence J(y)≤max⁡iJ(si)J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)J(y)≤maxi​J(si​). If two or more qiq_iqi​ are nonzero, equality would require equality in the entropy power inequality, hence Gaussian sis_isi​ for those indices, and then J(y)=0J(y) = 0J(y)=0; so if max⁡jJ(sj)>0\max_j J(s_j) > 0maxj​J(sj​)>0, equality forces q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​, and then J(y)=J(si)J(y) = J(s_i)J(y)=J(si​) must be the maximum. In whitened coordinates, the global maximum of J(w⊤z)J(\bw^\top\bz)J(w⊤z) on the sphere is therefore attained exactly at the sources of largest negentropy. The argument says nothing about other local maxima; unlike Theorem 5.3定理 5.3, it does not rule them out.

由归纳法，该不等式可推广到有限个独立变量之和：e2H(∑iXi)≥∑ie2H(Xi)e^{2H(\sum_i X_i)} \ge \sum_i e^{2H(X_i)}e2H(∑i​Xi​)≥∑i​e2H(Xi​)，等号仅当所有 XiX_iXi​ 都是高斯时成立。对满足 qi≠0q_i \neq 0qi​=0 的下标取 Xi=qisiX_i = q_i s_iXi​=qi​si​。由 H(qisi)=H(si)+log⁡∣qi∣H(q_i s_i) = H(s_i) + \log|q_i|H(qi​si​)=H(si​)+log∣qi​∣ 得 e2H(Xi)=qi2e2H(si)e^{2H(X_i)} = q_i^2 e^{2H(s_i)}e2H(Xi​)=qi2​e2H(si​)。各源 sis_isi​ 与最终投影 yyy 的方差为一（缩放后的加项 XiX_iXi​ 通常不是），所以 H(⋅)=h−J(⋅)H(\cdot) = h - J(\cdot)H(⋅)=h−J(⋅)，其中 h=12log⁡(2πe)h = \frac12\log(2\pi e)h=21​log(2πe)，不等式变为 e−2J(y)≥∑iqi2e−2J(si)e^{-2J(y)} \ge \sum_i q_i^2 e^{-2J(s_i)}e−2J(y)≥∑i​qi2​e−2J(si​)。由于权重 qi2q_i^2qi2​ 之和为一，右边至少为 e−2max⁡iJ(si)e^{-2\max_i J(s_i)}e−2maxi​J(si​)，因此 J(y)≤max⁡iJ(si)J(y) \le \max_i J(s_i)J(y)≤maxi​J(si​)。若有两个或更多 qiq_iqi​ 非零，取等号就要求熵幂不等式取等号，从而这些下标对应的 sis_isi​ 都是高斯的，此时 J(y)=0J(y) = 0J(y)=0；所以当 max⁡jJ(sj)>0\max_j J(s_j) > 0maxj​J(sj​)>0 时，等号迫使 q=±ei\bq = \pm\be_iq=±ei​，而此时 J(y)=J(si)J(y) = J(s_i)J(y)=J(si​) 必须是最大值。换到白化坐标下，J(w⊤z)J(\bw^\top\bz)J(w⊤z) 在球面上的全局最大值恰好在负熵最大的源处取得。这一论证对其他局部极大点只字未提；与Theorem 5.3定理 5.3不同，它并不排除它们的存在。
